description: An integer index wrapped by the array's own proven-positive length is in range by construction: (i % #xs) + 1 lands in [1, #xs], so the element read publishes presence and reads T rather than T?. The proof is tied to that array's length, so wrapping by another array's length or wrapping a float dividend leaves the read optional.

facts.name: the self-wrapped read is proven present
facts.subject: xs

facts.name: wrapping by another array's length proves nothing
facts.subject: zs
